# GLAD Vulkan loader

`include/glad/vulkan.h` is the header-only Vulkan 1.3 loader generated by
GLAD 2.0.0-beta and distributed with GLFW 3.4's source dependencies.

PrismRender vendors this generated header so Vulkan builds only require a
system Vulkan runtime. Vulkan functions are resolved through
`glfwGetInstanceProcAddress`; a separately installed Vulkan SDK is not needed
to compile the project.
